notes.title: Update v0.8.3
notes.content:
I've noticed that early VR games often have an issue where the headset works fine, but the VR controllers aren't recognized, preventing users from even getting past the main menu. Another common frustration is thumbstick drift on VR controllers. This Day 1 update aims to minimize both of these problems.

[list]
[*]Settings have a dead zone slider for analog thumbstick
[*]Early keyboard support for page navigation and book handling. You still need a VR controller for Library and File Browser
[/list]
